_notes: One token set per block. All 'text'/'muted' values pass WCAG AA (≥4.5:1) on 'background' and 'surface'. 'primary' passes AA on white for text/link use. 'accent' is decorative (borders, tints, icons) unless 'accent_text_safe' is given — use that darker shade when accent-coloured text is needed. 'variant' names the ONE token swapped to differentiate two same-block clinics in the same sector, with a pre-approved alternate value.

dental.imagery: Bright, clean clinical spaces; natural daylight; genuine smiles; no stock-surgery close-ups.

vet.imagery: Warm, candid animals-with-people moments; soft textures; approachable, never sterile.

ent.imagery: Calm, uncluttered; symptom-first diagrams and clear iconography over lifestyle photography.

ophthalmology.imagery: Precise, tech-forward; equipment and optics detail shots; cool light; crisp geometry.

derm-aesthetic.imagery: Editorial, light-flooded; soft neutral textures (linen, stone); skin detail treated respectfully; no before/after unless compliance-gated ON.

plastic-surgery.imagery: Premium restraint: deep tones, generous whitespace, architectural interiors; credentials-forward, zero sensationalism.
